top_signals.title: Before US Rate Bets Wiped Out Billions, Warnings Were Ignored in Chile
top_signals.summary: It was a desperate appeal to regulators: Step in, they were urged, and put a stop to this reckless behavior. It came as Chilean pension funds were making outsized bets on US interest rates, more than a year before a painful blowup left them billions of dollars in the red.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
